components.name: Accordion
components.purpose: An accordion stacks sections whose content shows and hides when their heading is pressed, such as an FAQ.

components.name: Alert
components.purpose: An alert shows a message about the page or the result of an action: information, success, a warning or an error.

components.name: AppsNotifications
components.purpose: A settings panel with one switch per app, to turn each app’s notifications on or off.

components.name: Avatar
components.purpose: An avatar represents a person or team with their photo, or their initials when there’s no photo.

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: A badge is a small, non-interactive label for a status (“Paid”, “New”) or a count (3 unread).

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.purpose: A breadcrumb shows where the current page sits in the site’s hierarchy, with links back up each level.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: A button triggers an action in place: saving a form, opening a dialog, deleting an item.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.purpose: A button group shows related buttons together, spaced or attached into one control.

components.name: Card
components.purpose: A card groups content and actions about one subject, such as an article, a product or a person, into a single container.

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: A checkbox turns one option on or off, or lets people pick any number of options from a list.

components.name: ChooseCard
components.purpose: Choose cards are large radio buttons: each option is a card with a name, a description and an optional price, and people pick exactly one.

components.name: Code
components.purpose: Code shows code inline in text or as a block with a language label and a copy button.

components.name: Combobox
components.purpose: A combobox is a text field with a list of suggestions: people type to filter and pick one option, or several shown as removable chips.

components.name: Container
components.purpose: Container centers page content with a maximum width and page gutters that follow density, with smaller gutters on phones..

components.name: Divider
components.purpose: A divider is a thin line that separates groups of content, horizontally or vertically, optionally with a short label such as “or”..

components.name: Drawer
components.purpose: A drawer is a panel that slides in from an edge of the screen for secondary tasks such as filters, settings or item details.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.purpose: A dropdown menu shows a list of actions or options when people press a button.

components.name: EmptyState
components.purpose: An empty state fills a space that has nothing to show yet, like an empty list or no search results, and explains why and what to do next..

components.name: Footer
components.purpose: The page footer: a copyright line and secondary links such as Privacy, Terms and Help.

components.name: FormField
components.purpose: FormField puts a label, help text and an error or success message around a form control and wires them together, so screen readers announce the label, hint and error with the control.

components.name: Grid
components.purpose: Grid lays children out in equal columns: a fixed number, or as many as fit (auto), so it reflows on small screens..

components.name: Header
components.purpose: A page header that introduces a person and their page: avatar, name, job title and the page heading.

components.name: HoverCard
components.purpose: A hover card previews what a link points to, such as a person’s profile, when a mouse user points at it or a keyboard user focuses it.

components.name: Inline
components.purpose: Inline lays its children out in a row that wraps onto more lines, e.g.

components.name: InputField
components.purpose: An input field lets people enter a single line of text: a name, an email address, a search term.

components.name: Kbd
components.purpose: Kbd shows a keyboard key or a shortcut, such as Ctrl + K, in text, menus and tooltips..

components.name: Link
components.purpose: A link takes people to another page or place.

components.name: List
components.purpose: A list shows related items one per row, with an optional icon or avatar, a second line and trailing meta such as a date.

components.name: Logo
components.purpose: The logo shows the product’s mark and name, usually at the start of the navigation bar, linking to the home page.

components.name: MeetingCard
components.purpose: A meeting card shows one event in an agenda or schedule: its name, time and attendees, with a color edge for its status.

components.name: Modal
components.purpose: A modal is a dialog over the page that people must deal with before going back: a short form, a confirmation or details.

components.name: Navbar
components.purpose: The navigation bar at the top of a site or app: the logo, links to the main sections, and optional actions such as search.

components.name: Pagination
components.purpose: Pagination moves between pages of a long list or table.

components.name: Popover
components.purpose: A popover shows interactive content anchored to a button, such as a small form, filters or details.

components.name: ProductCard
components.purpose: A product card shows one product in a grid or list: photo, name, short description, rating and price, with an optional sale price and actions.

components.name: Progress
components.purpose: A progress bar shows how far a task has got, such as an upload or setup steps.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.purpose: A radio group lets people pick exactly one option from a short list, with every option visible at once.

components.name: SearchField
components.purpose: A search field has a search icon, a clear button and an optional keyboard shortcut that focuses it from anywhere on the page.

components.name: Select
components.purpose: A select lets people pick one option from a list that opens below the field.

components.name: SideNav
components.purpose: A side navigation lists the pages of an app or docs site in sections, with icons and nested groups that expand and collapse.

components.name: Skeleton
components.purpose: A skeleton is a grey placeholder in the shape of content that is loading: lines of text, image blocks and avatar circles.

components.name: Slider
components.purpose: A slider sets a number, or a range with two thumbs, by dragging along a track or with the arrow keys.

components.name: Spinner
components.purpose: A spinner shows that something is loading when the time it takes is unknown.

components.name: Stack
components.purpose: Stack lays its children out vertically with even spacing from the density-aware spacing scale..

components.name: Stat
components.purpose: A stat shows one key figure with its label and change, such as revenue up 12.5% vs last month.

components.name: Stepper
components.purpose: A stepper shows progress through a task with several steps, such as checkout: which steps are done, which is current and what’s left.

components.name: Switch
components.purpose: A switch turns a single setting on or off and applies the change immediately, like a light switch.

components.name: Table
components.purpose: A table shows rows and columns of data people compare: sortable columns, selectable rows with select-all, a sticky header, striped or compact rows, and loading and empty states.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: Tabs switch between related views of content in the same place, one at a time.

components.name: Tag
components.purpose: A tag labels an item with a keyword or category.

components.name: Textarea
components.purpose: A multi-line text field for longer answers such as messages, comments or descriptions.

components.name: Toast
components.purpose: A toast is a brief message about something that just happened, such as “Changes saved”, shown in a corner and dismissed automatically.

components.name: Tooltip
components.purpose: A tooltip shows a short text hint for a control when it’s hovered or focused, such as the name of an icon button.
